# TrackCell

The standard track identity: "Artist – Title" on line one, mix name · label · duration on line two, plus the now-playing marker, flags and service links.

`SongNodes.TrackCell` · Music

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.TrackCell artist="…" title="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.TrackCell" artist="…" title="…"></x-import>
```

## Props (TrackCellProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `artist` * | `string` | Artist credit as shown ("Fred again.."). |
| `title` * | `string` | Track title without the mix name. |
| `mix` | `string` | Mix name ("Extended mix", "VIP"). |
| `label` | `string` | Record label. |
| `durationSec` | `number` | Duration in seconds; shown as "6:12". |
| `now` | `boolean` | Marks the now-playing track. |
| `needsEnergyCheck` | `boolean` | Energy is estimated and needs a listen. |
| `needsBeatportCheck` | `boolean` | Beatport match is uncertain. |
| `links` | `{ service: "TIDAL" \| "Deezer" \| "Beatport" \| "Spotify"; href: string }[]` | Service links shown as small external text links. |
| `compact` | `boolean` | One-line compact form for 32px rows. |
